stories.title: Chester Zoo: ‘World-first’ cancer treatment saves python after tumour destroys part of her jaw
stories.summary: A 15-foot python at Chester Zoo has been declared free of cancer after vets adapted a treatment used on human patients for use in a snake. stories.title: Flintshire’s funding formula is under review, but not in time for next year’s budget
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has commissioned a review of the formula used to decide how much funding Flintshire County Council receives, with any change unable to take effect before 2028-29. stories.title: Oakenholt mill gets £2.85m upgrade with hydrogen-ready burners
stories.summary: Essity is to spend £2.85 million upgrading the paper machine at its Oakenholt mill near Flint. The Swedish company, whose brands include Velvet, Cushelle, Tork and TENA, said the work will replace the machine’s hood, burner and heat exchange systems. stories.title: Burst water mains hit supplies in Queensferry and Nercwys
stories.summary: Two burst water mains have left homes in Queensferry and around Mold with low pressure or no water on Saturday. Dŵr Cymru Welsh Water says one burst is affecting Pierce Street in Queensferry, and a second is affecting Nercwys and surrounding areas of Mold.
